entries.2c469b271642487d: A company that undertakes facility construction work such as electrical work and piping work on contract from private companies, government agencies and the Tokyo Electric Power group.
entries.2f8b2ad363035df0: A category combining electrical equipment sales, real estate business, leasing business and power generation business, which is not included in the reportable segments. Kanko Shoji Co., Ltd. sells electrical materials such as electric wires; the company and Kasset Management Co., Ltd. run the real estate business; and Choshi Wind Power Development Co., Ltd., Kama Solar Power Generation Co., Ltd. and Maebashi Biomass Power Generation Co., Ltd. run the power generation business. The company, Choshi Wind Power Development Co., Ltd. and Maebashi Biomass Power Generation Co., Ltd. sell electricity to the Tokyo Electric Power Group. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,374 million.
entries.63c285675984d555: A business that undertakes all kinds of facilities construction, including electrical construction and pipe construction (air conditioning, water supply and drainage, etc.). The company and construction firms centered on subsidiaries across the Kanto region share the construction work; the company outsources part of the construction, security at construction sites, and design and estimating work to group companies. The company and Tower Line Solutions Co., Ltd. also receive electrical construction orders from the Tokyo Electric Power Group. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥731,647 million, accounting for the majority of group revenue.
